reviews.text: Kindness and expertise are useless if everything is charged at triple the price.
Clean, tidy, nice smelling office. The receptionist is very nice. Thank you Dr. Fanni Vrabély and her assistant for their work.

Today was our first time at the clinic with my cat and we left very happy. Although we still have the tests ahead of us, I feel my cat is in absolutely good hands. They were incredibly patient, they took their time, she is a bit more combative, but they managed to treat her very well, they didn't stress her unnecessarily, they didn't try to force her down. We found a way to get the lab done almost stress-free. So far, my problem in most places has been that there wasn't really time to discuss the problem, they were in a hurry. This was absolutely not the case here. They gave me an appointment right away so that we could talk through everything. The doctor questioned me in detail, asked for her previous papers in advance, and by the time I went, she had already made a note of the things she definitely wanted to mention. Her medical record was also much, much more detailed than anywhere else before, everything was listed on it. The cat got a treat, a bag of food to try, and a small toy pheasant feather. :) They also grow catnip, which they give to patients, upon request. I recommend the team to everyone. :)

I would give it 0 stars if I could, but unfortunately I'm limited. It's an unpleasant place, a huge money grab, an average examination that consists of the doctor holding the animal, putting it on the scale and then saying 30k. And you just sit there and wait. And they can do this without any worries, since they don't officially publish prices, so you can only hope that the doctor didn't wake up with a limp and doesn't want to shave you.
I haven't been to the office many times, but the doctor who brings us here has been treating my dogs for many years, so I know they are in the best hands with him.

They take care of my cat since he was 10 weeks old. He had a birth defect and  Caladrius team helped with everything, always dedicated and always answering all my nervous questions. Now my cat is 3 years old and we go once a year for check-ups, vaccine, deworming, ultrasound, blood test, and now they also have veterinary dentist which made my life easier. I feel safer and reassured by the treatment and I know my cat is safe with them.

Kind, expert staff, the doctor was very attentive and kind. They treated my cat very well, they really tried to make it as stress-free as possible. The consultation after the examination was also informative. And thanks for the catnip :)

This is the first veterinary clinic where they really took into account that my cat is very anxious and afraid of the vet. They always pay extra attention to her: there is a separate waiting room for cats, soothing music is played, and it is clear that they love animals (thanks for the catnip 😊).

The doctor is very conscientious, took the time to learn about the cat's medical history - who is 15 years old and already has several problems due to his age - and always looks for the most gentle, best solution for him. After the examination, I always get a detailed, written summary, and they monitor the condition of their patients.

The doctor's knowledge and attitude are exceptional, and her assistant is very kind and supportive - they make a really good team. I can only recommend them.

Beautiful waiting room, separate for cats and separate for dogs.
Very nice welcome, cute and enthusiastic doctors!
10/10

Although a visit to the doctor is usually not associated with positive feelings, this is absolutely not the case with Caladrius. We were lucky enough to see all the doctors at the practice, and I can safely say that they are very professional. If we call them on the phone, the assistant lady knows the answer to everything, is helpful and very kind. The practice is always spotlessly clean, there is a separate waiting room for dogs and separate waiting rooms for cats. Dr. Vass is very thorough and careful, precise and conscientious, she pays 110% attention to my puppy during every examination, and the Caladrius team is always interested in further developments if we need to go to a specialized practice. They always provide a contact for a practice where I would entrust my dog ​​to anyone without thinking twice. They always inform us about the prices in advance, there are never any surprises. We have been coming here for years, we hope to be able to visit the Caladrius team for a long time to come.
The examination room was not air-conditioned, and they made us wait a long time (even though we arrived on time), but they were very friendly with the cat.
